name: StartupJobsBot
description: Tiny service that takes candidate webhook from Startupsjob and announces the candidate on Slack and adds them to Recruitee.

RECRUITEE_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: Access token for Recruitee. Required if you want to integrate with Recruitee. Look to official documentation on how to obtain it: https://docs.recruitee.com/reference#reference-getting-started

RECRUITEE_DOMAIN.description: Recruitee domain for your company. Required if you want to integrate with Recruitee. Example: '123456'

RECRUITEE_FALLBACK_OFFER_ID.description: Numeric id of the Recruitee offer (ideally a dedicated talent pool) that receives candidates who cannot be matched to any active offer. Without it such candidates do not reach Recruitee. Run 'yarn offers' or open the talent pool in Recruitee to find the id.

STARTUPJOBS_API_TOKEN.description: StartupJobs company API token. Enables the reconciler, which periodically pulls applications from StartupJobs and imports those missing in Recruitee.

RECONCILE_DRY_RUN.description: While 'true' the reconciler only reports to Slack what it would import. Set to 'false' once a report looks right.

RECONCILE_INTERVAL_MINUTES.description: How often the reconciler runs. 0 turns the periodic run off.

RECONCILE_LOOKBACK_DAYS.description: How many days back each reconciler run checks.

RECONCILE_MAX_IMPORTS_PER_RUN.description: Safety limit of candidates imported by one reconciler run.

RECONCILE_TAG.description: Optional Recruitee tag put on candidates imported by the reconciler.

DAILY_CHECK_HOUR.description: Hour (0-23, in BOT_TIMEZONE) of the daily check that reports StartupJobs offers which would not find a Recruitee offer and candidates waiting in the fallback pool. -1 turns it off.

WEEKLY_SUMMARY_HOUR.description: Hour (0-23, in BOT_TIMEZONE) of the Monday summary of last week's applications. -1 turns it off.

FALLBACK_REMINDER_WORKDAYS.description: Working days a candidate may wait in the fallback pool before the daily check mentions them.

BOT_TIMEZONE.description: Time zone for the scheduled reports.

SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL.description: Incoming webhook integration url from Slack. See: https://api.slack.com/messaging/webhooks on how to se it up.

SLACK_MESSAGE_TITLE.description: Customize the title of slack notification about new candidate

SLACK_REPORT_ERRORS.description: Should errors be reported into slack? Default is false. Set to 'true' if you want to have it turned on.

GMAIL_EMAIL.description: Gmail address to send emails from. Required if you want to send email notifications to candidates.

GMAIL_PASSWORD.description: Gmail password or app-specific password for the email account. Required if you want to send email notifications to candidates.

GMAIL_SUBJECT_TEMPLATE.description: Custom template for email subject. Use {position} as placeholder for the position name.

GMAIL_BODY_TEMPLATE.description: Custom template for email body. Use {name}, {position}, and {recruiteeId} as placeholders. HTML formatting is supported.
GMAIL_BODY_TEMPLATE.value:
Hey there! 👋

Thanks so much for your interest in working at Applifting! We got your CV, and we're going to get to it soon.

Before we get in touch with you, we'd like to send you a couple of things to help you better understand where you're applying and who your future colleagues might be.

You can read about our culture on GitHub, and we have a lot on our blog, where you can also find the latest article published for our 10th anniversary this year. The article summarizes everything our founders Filip and Vrata said in a recorded podcast here. 🤗

If that wasn't enough, I'm posting 2 more podcasts with the Applifting founders where you can learn about us in real depth:

Podcast with Filip 🎧
Podcast with Vráťa 🎧

What's next? We're going to check out your CV and get back to you within a week tops. 🙂
Thanks and take care!

LOG_REQUESTS.description: Log requests into console. On by default. Set to 'false' to turn it onff.

LOG_PAYLOADS.description: Log request payloads into console. Set to 'true' to turn it on.
